text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a set of rules it can follow. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model has learned, and developers often improve the model by giving it more or better training data.
